premise: At 57, after 29 years as a hospital housekeeper, I paid off my $230,000 bungalow, but my stepson, who moved in as my caregiver during a shoulder replacement, forged a trustee deed transferring the house to himself as rent and sold it to a real-estate wholesaler for $345,000, mailing me a $4,600 cleaning-fee check; I proved the electronic filing came from his girlfriend's IP address and voided the sale, then used the judgment to seize his dump-truck and hauling business, and now run 'Haul of Deceit Junk Removal,' where he shovels debris in a smock that says 'Foreclosed My Trust' and every dump ticket prints his deed-fraud docket.
